steps.title: Find a safe place to stay
steps.text: Temporary housing from the community is free: you pay only for utilities. Apply to the executive body of the local council or the Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП) where you are registered as an IDP. Priority goes to large families and families with children, pregnant women, people with disabilities, military families, and those relocating for the second time. Free housing may not be available right away; you will be put on a waiting list.
steps.where: Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП) or the executive body of the community council

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)
DTKT: procedure for providing IDPs with housing for temporary residence (Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 495)

steps.title: Tell your family you are safe
steps.text: One short message eases panic and frees up the lines. Save your new address in “Mine” so it's at hand.

steps.title: Check your documents
steps.text: If your passport is lost, it can be restored at any Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП), migration service office or Passport Service wherever you are now. If it was stolen, go to the police first. Until you have a new one, your identity can be confirmed temporarily by a passport for travel abroad, a driving licence or documents in Diia.
steps.where: Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП), migration service, Passport Service

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers / State Migration Service: step-by-step guide if your passport is lost
State Migration Service: what to do if your passport is lost

steps.title: Register as an IDP
steps.text: Apply in Diia, at an Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП) or at a social protection office. It's free. Over time, an extract from the unified database will replace the certificate; for now, certificates are still issued. Certificates issued earlier remain valid, and nothing needs to be reissued. The registration procedure is being updated, so check before you apply.
steps.where: Diia, Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП), social protection office

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)
Ministry of Social Policy: new IDP registration system, certificates remain valid

steps.title: Moved again? Report it within 30 days
steps.text: An IDP must report a new place of residence or a return home within 30 calendar days. Otherwise you may be removed from the register.
steps.where: Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП) or the executive body of the council

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)

steps.title: Apply for the living allowance
steps.text: As of 31.10.2026: UAH 3,000 a month for children and people with disabilities, UAH 2,000 for others, for 6 months. Who is eligible and whether it is extended depends on where you left from, your income and your household. People able to work who apply for the first time must, within 3 months, find a job, register as a sole trader (ФОП) or register with the employment centre. The rules change: check with the Pension Fund.
steps.where: Diia, Pension Fund portal or app, Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП)

sources.title: Pension Fund: how IDPs can apply for the living allowance
Pension Fund: conditions for extending IDP payments in 2026

steps.title: Enrol children in school and kindergarten
steps.text: IDP children have the right to a kindergarten and school place where one of their parents is registered. Schools accept children even without a birth certificate or residence registration, and the medical certificate can be brought before classes start. From 1.09.2026, pupils of municipal schools studying in person or in blended mode get free meals.
steps.where: A nearby school or kindergarten, the community's education department

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)
osvita.ua: school enrolment for IDP children (Ministry of Education and Science Order No. 367)
Cabinet of Ministers: free meals for all pupils of municipal schools

steps.title: Find a family doctor
steps.text: Primary care is provided even without residence registration or a declaration. Sign a new declaration with a doctor where you live: they will write prescriptions, including under the Affordable Medicines programme («Доступні ліки»). The National Health Service (НСЗУ) contact centre, 16-77, can tell you the nearest clinic.
steps.where: Nearest outpatient clinic, National Health Service (НСЗУ) 16-77

sources.title: Ministry of Health: displaced people receive medical services regardless of registration

steps.title: Record lost property
steps.text: Damaged or destroyed housing: a notification and an application in eVidnovlennia (єВідновлення) via Diia, an Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП) or a notary. Separately, a claim to the international Register of Damage via Diia: it records the damage for future compensation. Don't risk your life for photos: housing in combat zones is surveyed remotely.

sources.title: Diia: damaged property (eVidnovlennia / єВідновлення)
Register of Damage for Ukraine (Council of Europe): all categories open

steps.title: A job or your own business
steps.text: The employment centre will help you find work and retrain, and tell you about the training voucher. There are grants for starting your own business (+20 % for IDPs with experience) and compensation for employers who hire IDPs. The employment service contact centre is 1518, free of charge.

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers: employment service contact centre 1518 and the training voucher
Diia: grant for your own business

steps.title: Free legal aid
steps.text: Documents, housing, payments, debts: a lawyer will advise you for free. Phone 0 800 213 103, Mon–Fri 8:00–18:00, the call is free.

sources.title: Judiciary of Ukraine: free legal aid

steps.title: Find your people: the IDP council and people from home
steps.text: Many communities have IDP councils; under the model regulation, half of the members are displaced people. The authorities are obliged to consider their proposals. Come to the meetings, make proposals, look for people from your home area.
steps.where: Executive body of the council, Administrative Services Centre (ЦНАП), social services centre

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)
Ministry of Social Policy: legislation for IDPs (regulation on IDP councils)

steps.title: Longer-term housing
steps.text: Renting, the eOselia (єОселя) programme and housing programmes for IDPs. For now, housing vouchers are only for IDPs from occupied territories who have combatant status or a disability caused by the war. The terms change: check in Diia.

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers: housing voucher programme for IDPs from occupied territories
eOselia (єОселя)

steps.title: Become part of your new community
steps.text: Volunteering, volunteer formations of territorial communities (ДФТГ), helping other displaced people, a neighbourhood network. Your skills are needed here: this is how a new place becomes your own.

steps.title: Stay connected to your home region
steps.text: A community of people from home, the history of your village or town, remembering those who were killed, plans for returning. A community that has not been scattered is resistance too.
steps.where: IDP council, community organisations of people from your home area

steps.title: Look after yourself
steps.text: Grief, anger and sleeplessness after losing your home are normal reactions. Routine, movement, sleep and talking with loved ones help. Free psychological support is available through your family doctor.

sources.title: National Health Service (НСЗУ): free psychological and psychiatric care in the Medical Guarantees Programme

steps.title: Temporary protection in the EU
steps.text: Temporary protection for Ukrainians in the EU has been extended until 4 March 2028. New applicants who are subject to military obligations must show that they have fulfilled them in Ukraine (for example, a lawful exit or a deferral). This does not apply to those who already have protection.
steps.where: Migration service of your host country

sources.title: EUR-Lex: Council of the EU Decision (EU) 2026/1912
EU Delegation to Ukraine: protection extended until March 2028

steps.title: Temporary consular registration
steps.text: Register at the embassy or consulate: in person, through a legal representative or by registered letter. It makes things easier with documents and assistance.

sources.title: Diia: temporary consular registration

steps.title: IDP status and staying connected to home
steps.text: IDP status is removed if a person stays abroad for more than 90 days in a row or more than 180 days within a year, except for valid reasons set by the government. Diia and claims to the Register of Damage are available from abroad too.

sources.title: Law of Ukraine No. 4924-IX “On Ensuring the Rights and Freedoms of Internally Displaced Persons” («Про забезпечення прав і свобод внутрішньо переміщених осіб») (in force from 22.10.2026)

steps.title: Your contribution, from there too
steps.text: Volunteering, fundraising, telling the truth about the war in your new country, Ukrainian language and culture for your children, staying in touch with family back home. You are part of the resistance, wherever you are.
